english: Schedule for the 2026 Safety and Environment Training for Research Personnel (New-Entrant Training) in November

- Research personnel (people who do research in labs) who have not yet completed the new-entrant safety and environment training (this training is a requirement for graduate school and for 논자시 (thesis qualifying exam) eligibility)
- 20 Nov 2026 (Fri) 09:30~18:30 (Environmental Health and Safety Center, Building 98, Room 101)
- Bottled water (no other drinks allowed) and writing materials (no parking discount tickets or lunch will be provided)
- Send an email with your department, name, portal ID, personal contact number and other details ( kss777@snu.ac.kr )
- Attendance will be checked at random times during the training (if you leave without permission, you will be marked as not having completed the training)
- Registration will close early if there are not enough seats
- Additional training sessions are planned for December or January
